engines.name: Engines & Nacelles
engines.description: High-bypass turbofans in under-wing nacelles: fan, core, gearbox accessories, ignition, start and oil systems.

apu.name: Auxiliary Power Unit
apu.description: Small gas turbine in the tail cone supplying electrical power and bleed air for engine start and air conditioning.

landing-gear.name: Landing Gear, Wheels & Brakes
landing-gear.description: Nose and main gear legs, retraction, steering, wheels, tyres and carbon brakes with anti-skid.

flight-controls.name: Flight Controls
flight-controls.description: Primary and secondary control surfaces with their actuators, sensors and computers.

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic Power
hydraulics.description: Engine- and electrically-driven pumps, reservoirs, accumulators and filtration for three independent systems.

fuel.name: Fuel System
fuel.description: Wing and centre tanks, boost pumps, valves, quantity probes and the refuel panel.

electrical.name: Electrical Power
electrical.description: Generators, transformer-rectifiers, batteries, contactors and distribution panels.

avionics.name: Avionics & Navigation
avionics.description: Displays, flight computers, radios, navigation sensors and the probes that feed them.

lighting.name: Lighting
lighting.description: Exterior navigation, strobe, beacon, landing and taxi lights, plus cabin and emergency lighting.

air-conditioning.name: Air Conditioning & Pneumatics
air-conditioning.tagline: Air you can breathe at 37,000 ft.
air-conditioning.description: Air-conditioning packs, pressurisation control, bleed air valves and cabin air recirculation.

cabin.name: Cabin & Interior
cabin.description: Seats, galleys, lavatories, oxygen, water and waste systems, and cabin furnishings.

doors-windows.name: Doors & Windows
doors-windows.description: Passenger, service, cargo and emergency exits, cockpit windshields and cabin windows.

protection.name: Fire, Ice & Rain Protection
protection.description: Fire detection and extinguishing, wing and engine anti-ice, probe heating and windshield rain removal.

consumables.name: Filters & Consumables
consumables.description: Filters, seals, fluids, lamps and hardware replaced at routine maintenance checks.

Rotable.name: Rotable
Rotable.info: Serialised component that is overhauled and returned to stock. Usually supplied on exchange with a certificate (EASA Form 1 / FAA 8130-3).

Repairable.name: Repairable
Repairable.info: Component that can be repaired a limited number of times before it is scrapped.

Expendable.name: Expendable
Expendable.info: Low-cost hardware replaced rather than repaired.

Consumable.name: Consumable
Consumable.info: Used up in service: fluids, filters, seals, lamps and similar.

fan-blade-set.name: Fan Blade Set
fan-blade-set.description: Wide-chord titanium or composite fan blades producing most of the engine's thrust. Inspected for erosion and impact damage.

spinner-cone.name: Spinner Cone
spinner-cone.description: Aerodynamic nose cone over the fan hub that guides airflow and sheds ice.

engine-inlet-cowl.name: Engine Inlet Cowl
engine-inlet-cowl.description: Leading section of the nacelle that delivers smooth airflow to the fan, with anti-ice ducting.

fan-cowl-door.name: Fan Cowl Door
fan-cowl-door.description: Hinged cowl panels giving access to the fan case and accessory gearbox.

thrust-reverser-actuator.name: Thrust Reverser Actuator
thrust-reverser-actuator.description: Hydraulic or electric actuator that deploys the reverser sleeve to slow the aircraft after touchdown.

fuel-metering-unit.name: Fuel Metering Unit
fuel-metering-unit.description: Meters fuel flow to the combustor on command of the engine control computer.

engine-control-unit-fadec.name: Engine Control Unit (FADEC)
engine-control-unit-fadec.description: Dual-channel full-authority digital engine control that manages thrust, start and limits.

ignition-exciter.name: Ignition Exciter
ignition-exciter.description: High-energy unit that powers the igniter plugs during start and in-flight relight.

igniter-plug.name: Igniter Plug
igniter-plug.description: Spark plug that lights the fuel-air mixture in the combustor. Replaced at set intervals.

pneumatic-starter.name: Pneumatic Starter
pneumatic-starter.description: Air turbine starter that spins the engine core using APU or ground bleed air.

starter-air-valve.name: Starter Air Valve
starter-air-valve.description: Controls the flow of start air to the pneumatic starter.

oil-pump-assembly.name: Oil Pump Assembly
oil-pump-assembly.description: Pressure and scavenge pump unit that circulates oil through bearings and gearboxes.

oil-quantity-transmitter.name: Oil Quantity Transmitter
oil-quantity-transmitter.description: Sensor that reports engine oil level to the cockpit displays.

exhaust-nozzle-and-plug.name: Exhaust Nozzle & Plug
exhaust-nozzle-and-plug.description: Shapes the core exhaust stream for efficient thrust and lower noise.

engine-pylon-fairing.name: Engine Pylon Fairing
engine-pylon-fairing.description: Aerodynamic fairing over the strut that attaches the engine to the wing.

apu-power-section.name: APU Power Section
apu-power-section.description: Gas-turbine core of the APU that drives the generator and supplies bleed air.

apu-starter-motor.name: APU Starter Motor
apu-starter-motor.description: DC electric motor that spins the APU up to self-sustaining speed.

apu-generator.name: APU Generator
apu-generator.description: AC generator providing aircraft electrical power on the ground and as a backup in flight.

apu-electronic-control-box.name: APU Electronic Control Box
apu-electronic-control-box.description: Controls APU start, speed, temperature and protective shutdowns.

apu-air-inlet-door-actuator.name: APU Air Inlet Door Actuator
apu-air-inlet-door-actuator.description: Opens and closes the APU air inlet flap.

apu-fuel-control-unit.name: APU Fuel Control Unit
apu-fuel-control-unit.description: Schedules fuel flow to the APU combustor.

apu-exhaust-muffler.name: APU Exhaust Muffler
apu-exhaust-muffler.description: Ducts and silences APU exhaust gas out of the tail.

main-landing-gear-shock-strut.name: Main Landing Gear Shock Strut
main-landing-gear-shock-strut.description: Oleo-pneumatic leg that absorbs landing loads and supports the aircraft on the ground.

nose-landing-gear-shock-strut.name: Nose Landing Gear Shock Strut
nose-landing-gear-shock-strut.description: Oleo strut carrying the nose wheels, with integrated steering collar.

main-wheel-assembly.name: Main Wheel Assembly
main-wheel-assembly.description: Forged aluminium wheel with bearings and fusible plugs that release pressure if overheated.

nose-wheel-assembly.name: Nose Wheel Assembly
nose-wheel-assembly.description: Twin nose wheels supporting steering and nose loads.

main-tyre.name: Main Tyre
main-tyre.description: Radial or bias aircraft tyre inflated with nitrogen. Replaced or retreaded on wear limits.

nose-tyre.name: Nose Tyre
nose-tyre.description: Chined nose tyre that deflects runway water away from the engines.

carbon-brake-assembly.name: Carbon Brake Assembly
carbon-brake-assembly.description: Multi-disc carbon heat-sink brake with wear indicator pins.

anti-skid-transducer.name: Anti-Skid Transducer
anti-skid-transducer.description: Wheel-speed sensor that lets the anti-skid system prevent wheel lock-up.

brake-control-valve.name: Brake Control Valve
brake-control-valve.description: Meters hydraulic pressure to the brakes on pedal or autobrake command.

retraction-actuator.name: Retraction Actuator
retraction-actuator.description: Hydraulic actuator that raises and lowers the gear leg.

nose-wheel-steering-actuator.name: Nose Wheel Steering Actuator
nose-wheel-steering-actuator.description: Turns the nose wheels for ground steering via tiller and rudder pedals.

gear-uplock-assembly.name: Gear Uplock Assembly
gear-uplock-assembly.description: Mechanical lock that holds the gear up in flight.

torque-link-assembly.name: Torque Link Assembly
torque-link-assembly.description: Scissor links that stop the inner cylinder rotating and transmit steering.

aileron-servo-actuator.name: Aileron Servo Actuator
aileron-servo-actuator.description: Hydraulic actuator that moves the aileron for roll control.

elevator-servo-actuator.name: Elevator Servo Actuator
elevator-servo-actuator.description: Drives the elevator for pitch control.

rudder-power-control-unit.name: Rudder Power Control Unit
rudder-power-control-unit.description: Hydraulic unit that drives the rudder for yaw control.

trimmable-horizontal-stabiliser-actuator.name: Trimmable Horizontal Stabiliser Actuator

flap-actuator.name: Flap Actuator
flap-actuator.description: Ball-screw actuator that extends the trailing-edge flaps.

slat-actuator.name: Slat Actuator
slat-actuator.description: Rotary actuator driving the leading-edge slats.

spoiler-actuator.name: Spoiler Actuator

flap-track-fairing.name: Flap Track Fairing
flap-track-fairing.description: Streamlined fairing over the flap support track ('canoe').

flight-control-computer.name: Flight Control Computer
flight-control-computer.description: Computes surface commands from pilot inputs and protections.

control-surface-position-sensor.name: Control Surface Position Sensor
control-surface-position-sensor.description: Reports actual surface position back to the flight control computers.

static-discharger-wick.name: Static Discharger (Wick)
static-discharger-wick.description: Bleeds static charge into the air to reduce radio interference.

engine-driven-hydraulic-pump.name: Engine-Driven Hydraulic Pump
engine-driven-hydraulic-pump.description: Variable-displacement pump supplying main system pressure.

electric-motor-driven-pump.name: Electric Motor-Driven Pump
electric-motor-driven-pump.description: Electric pump for backup pressure and ground operation.

power-transfer-unit.name: Power Transfer Unit
power-transfer-unit.description: Transfers hydraulic power between systems without mixing fluid.

hydraulic-reservoir.name: Hydraulic Reservoir
hydraulic-reservoir.description: Pressurised tank storing fluid for each hydraulic system.

hydraulic-accumulator.name: Hydraulic Accumulator
hydraulic-accumulator.description: Nitrogen-charged unit that dampens pressure surges and stores reserve energy.

ram-air-turbine-rat.name: Ram Air Turbine (RAT)

water-drain-valve.name: Water Drain Valve

transformer-rectifier-unit.name: Transformer Rectifier Unit

static-inverter.name: Static Inverter

power-contactor.name: Power Contactor

weather-radar-transceiver.name: Weather Radar Transceiver

vhf-communication-transceiver.name: VHF Communication Transceiver

pitot-probe.name: Pitot Probe

angle-of-attack-sensor.name: Angle-of-Attack Sensor

transponder.description: Replies to ATC and collision-avoidance interrogations.

static-port.name: Static Port

landing-light.name: Landing Light

taxi-and-turnoff-light.name: Taxi & Turnoff Light

cabin-led-light-strip.name: Cabin LED Light Strip

floor-path-marking.name: Floor Path Marking

cabin-pressure-controller.description: Schedules cabin altitude and rate of change.

overwing-exit-hatch-seal.name: Overwing Exit Hatch Seal
overwing-exit-hatch-seal.description: Seal for the self-help overwing emergency exits.

cabin-window-pane.name: Cabin Window Pane
cabin-window-pane.description: Outer and inner acrylic panes with breather hole.

engine-fire-detector-loop.description: Continuous sensing element that detects fire and overheat.

cargo-smoke-detector.description: Photo-electric detector for cargo hold smoke.

tyre-valve-core-kit.description: Valve cores and caps for nitrogen tyre servicing.
